title: Channel Capability
description: A functional feature a syndicate channel either grants or withholds. Missions derive required capabilities from their constraints; dispatch refuses a channel that cannot serve them.

requires.description: Capability slugs this one functionally depends on. A channel declaring this capability without its dependencies is an inconsistent declaration and is refused at validation.

category.description: generation: what the model emits. harness: what the surrounding runtime can reach. modality: input/output kinds. protocol: wire-level features.

harness_tools.description: Mission tool names that imply this capability. A mission whose allowed_tools contains any of these requires the capability, which is how MissionConstraints derive their requirement set without a hardcoded map.

hazard.description: What granting this capability puts at risk - drives briefing emphasis, not refusal
